DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約したい相談の内容をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what consultation you would like to book.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住まいのことと、仕事のことです。一回の予約で二つ話せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二つの相談内容を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is about housing and work. Can I discuss both in one appointment?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the two consultation topics. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住宅の相談と仕事の相談は、担当が分かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Housing and employment consultations have different staff in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一つの短い枠に二つとも入れても、同じ担当が答えられるとは限らないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一枠で両方できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So even if I put both into one short slot, the same person may not be able to answer both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether both can be handled in one slot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。先に必要なご相談を伺い、それぞれご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. We will first ask what advice you need and direct you separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住まいの期限が近いので、まず住宅の相談を予約したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 担当が異なると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: My housing deadline is approaching, so I would like to book the housing consultation first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that the responsible staff differ. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。仕事の相談先は、この案内に連絡先があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. The employment consultation contact details are in this guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。住宅を先にし、仕事は別に連絡します。案内を混ぜないようにメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 先に相談したい内容を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will deal with housing first and contact the employment service separately. I will take notes so I do not mix up the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the topic you want to discuss first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 住宅の空きは、金曜の午前です。ご都合はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is a housing appointment available on Friday morning. Would that suit you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 金曜午前でお願いします。住宅の予約と、仕事の連絡先を別々に控えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次の相談先も控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Friday morning, please. I have noted the housing appointment and the employment contact separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Also note the next consultation contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。住宅の相談として予約を受け付けます。仕事のご相談は、案内の窓口へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will book this as a housing consultation. For employment advice, please contact the service in the guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 領収書についてのお問い合わせですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your inquiry is about a receipt, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。漢字は合っていますが、上のカナが私の読み方と違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 氏名の表記の違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The kanji is correct, but the kana above it is not how my name is pronounced.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the difference in how your name is written. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの部分が違っていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 姓は「カミヤ」です。「カミタ」と書かれています。漢字を別の人のものにするのではなく、読みを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 漢字と読みを分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My surname is “Kamiya.” It is written “Kamita.” I want to check the reading, not change the kanji to someone else's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the kanji and reading separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 登録情報と本日の書類を確認します。診察券も見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the registered information and today's documents. Please show your patient card too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。診察券のカナも同じ違いがあるので、登録から確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正しい読みを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. The kana on my patient card has the same error, so could you check the registration itself?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the correct reading. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。登録の担当と会計の担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. We will check with the registration and payment staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。領収書だけ手書きで直さず、正しい扱いを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 登録と発行書類の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I would like to ask about the proper procedure, rather than just correct the receipt by hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check both the registration and issued documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのままお預かりして、修正や再発行が必要か確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will take them as they are and check whether correction or reissuing is necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今の書類を切ったり捨てたりせず渡します。正しい読みはカミヤです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認前の書類をそのまま保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will hand over the current documents without cutting them or throwing them away. The correct reading is Kamiya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the documents unchanged until checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。漢字は一致しており、読みの確認が必要な件として担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will refer this as a case where the kanji matches but the reading needs checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 以前の紛失届についてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about your earlier lost-property report, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この控えです。眼鏡をなくしたと届けましたが、知人から見つけたと連絡がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 既存の紛失届を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Here is the copy. I reported losing my glasses, but an acquaintance has contacted me saying they found them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the existing lost-property report. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様の眼鏡だと確認できましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you confirmed they are your glasses?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。似ていると言われただけで、写真も現物も見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発見の連絡があったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. They only said they look similar; I have seen neither a photograph nor the actual glasses.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you received a message about the discovery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、発見が確定したわけではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So it has not been confirmed that they have been found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。先に「見つかった」と届けを終わらせるのではなく、確認後にどう連絡するか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現物未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's right. Rather than close the report by saying they have been found already, I want to ask how to contact you after checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not checked the actual item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お客様の物と確認できたら、この届の番号で担当へご連絡ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you confirm they are yours, contact the person in charge using this report number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号を使えば、元の届とつながるんですね。まず知人に写真を送ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認後の届の更新方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: So the number links it to my original report. I will first ask my acquaintance to send a photograph.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to update the report after checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真だけで分からなければ、現物の特徴もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If a photograph is not enough, please check the features of the actual item too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: つるの傷とケースを確認します。自分の眼鏡だと分かったら、この番号で結果を連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の物か確認して結果を連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the scratch on the temple and the case. Once I know they are my glasses, I will report the result using this number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check that the item is yours and report the result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今は発見の連絡はあったものの、ご本人の確認はまだとして伺いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. For now, we have heard that there was a message about a discovery, but you have not personally confirmed it yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to check missed-delivery notices, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同じ日に二枚入っていました。同じ荷物の通知が重なったのかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二枚の票があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Two were left on the same day. I thought they might be duplicate notices for the same parcel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have two notices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番号を比べると、最後の数字が違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Comparing the numbers, the final digits are different.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本当ですね。二枚を一件として扱わず、それぞれ確認した方がいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ荷物と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: You're right. I should check each one rather than treat the two notices as one item.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought they referred to the same parcel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。まず宛名と番号を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. First we will check the addressee and numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 両方とも私宛てです。一枚ずつ受け取れる状態か調べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号の違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Both are addressed to me. Could you check whether each one is ready for collection?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the difference in numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの番号と、もう一方の番号を別々に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check this number and the other number separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。一つ受け取れば全部終わりと思い込まないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二件それぞれの受取状況を調べてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will not assume collecting one means everything is finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check the collection status of both items separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認の結果、それぞれの受取方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, we will explain how to collect each one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二件分の結果を聞きます。まだ一枚を捨てず、二枚とも手元に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一件だけで終わらせず結果を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will listen to the results for both. I will not throw one away yet; I will keep both notices.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check both results without stopping after one item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つの番号を確認しますので、こちらで少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait here while we check the two numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの紛失についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about a lost card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。財布ごとないので、この銀行のカードと、別会社のクレジットカードを止めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 財布ごとの紛失を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My whole wallet is missing, so I want to stop this bank's card and a credit card from another company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the entire wallet is missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 当行のカードは、こちらで本人確認のうえ手続きをご案内します。他社のカードは発行元へご連絡ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: For our bank's card, we will verify your identity here and explain the procedure. For the other company's card, contact the issuer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここで二枚とも止まるわけではないんですね。この銀行のカードを先に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入っていたカードを分けて示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So both cards will not be stopped here. I will consult you about this bank's card first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the cards in the wallet separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。当行のカードを特定するための資料はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Do you have any documents to identify our bank's card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 口座の控えと本人確認書類があります。他社カードの情報は別のメモにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 銀行に依頼する対象を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my account details and identification documents. The other card's information is in a separate note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm which card you are asking the bank to handle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 当行分を確認します。他社分は、発行元の正式な連絡先をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check our bank's card. For the other card, please check the issuer's official contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの手続きが済んでも、他社への連絡を忘れないよう別に印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他社への連絡先も別に探すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will mark the other contact separately so I do not forget it even after this procedure is finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will also look up the other company's contact separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 停止の結果は担当者がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will tell you the result of the suspension.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この銀行のカードの結果を確認し、他社分も別に連絡します。財布全部の対応が一度で完了とは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 銀行分の結果を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the result for this bank's card and contact the other company separately. I will not assume everything in the wallet has been dealt with at once.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the result for the bank's card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。当行分の本人確認から進めます。資料をこちらへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We will start with identity verification for our bank's card. Please hand the documents here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品に気になる点がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was there something about the product that concerned you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 冷凍食品が柔らかくなりました。交換できるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現在の商品状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The frozen food has softened. I would like to ask whether it can be exchanged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the product's current condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入した時から、柔らかい状態でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Was it soft when you bought it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 買った時は固かったです。その後、冷凍庫へ入れずに三時間持ち歩いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入時は凍っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was hard when I bought it. Afterwards I carried it around for three hours without putting it in a freezer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it was frozen at purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入時と現在の状態が違うのですね。その経過を担当者へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: So its condition at purchase differs from now. I will tell the person in charge what happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。店で不良品だったと言うのではなく、私が持ち歩いたことも含めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち歩いた時間を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will not say it was defective at the shop; I will include the fact that I carried it around when consulting you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say how long you carried it around. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返品の条件と、商品の扱いについて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the return conditions and how the product should be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。交換の話だけでなく、今の状態で使ってよいか分からないので、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返品と食べられるかの判断を分けて質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Apart from the exchange, I do not know whether it is all right to use it in its current condition, so I want to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask separately about returning it and whether it is safe to eat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ここで安全に使えるとは判断できません。担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We cannot determine here that it is safe to use. The person in charge will advise you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ使わず、この状態と持ち歩いた時間を伝えて案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認前に使用せず案内を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not use it yet. I will explain this condition and how long I carried it around, then wait for guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not use it before checking; wait for guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。購入記録と保管の経過を確認し、担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the purchase record and storage history, then refer this to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 小川の向こうへ行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you going to the other side of the stream?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも飛び石がぬれていて、靴をぬらしたり滑ったりしそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 飛び石の状態が心配だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But the stepping stones are wet, and I might wet my shoes or slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are concerned about the stepping stones' condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 上流側に橋があります。こちらの道を回れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a bridge upstream. You can go around along this path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この分岐で右へ進めば、橋に着きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 橋を使う道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: If I go right at this fork, will I reach the bridge?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for the route using the bridge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。左は飛び石へ戻る道なので、右を選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. The left path returns to the stepping stones, so take the right one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 少し遠くても橋を使います。飛び石を急いで渡るのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 橋の方向と分岐を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will use the bridge even if it is a little further. I will not rush across the stepping stones.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the direction of the bridge and the fork. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 橋を渡った後は、川沿いを戻ると目的の広場へ着きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: After crossing the bridge, follow the river back to reach the square you want.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 橋を渡ってから川沿いですね。同じ広場に行けるなら、その迂回路で大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 短い道より足元の条件を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Along the river after crossing the bridge, right? If it reaches the same square, that detour is fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prioritize footing conditions over the shorter route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。雨上がりなので、橋の手前の足元もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. It has just rained, so watch the footing before the bridge too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 右の道へ回り、橋の状態も確かめて渡ります。帰りも飛び石は使わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同じ目的地へ迂回すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the right-hand path and check the bridge's condition before crossing. I will avoid the stepping stones on the way back too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take a detour to the same destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ。この地図に橋の位置を示しました。足元に気を付けてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. I have marked the bridge on this map. Watch your step as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらが乗車券と指定席券です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here are your journey ticket and reserved-seat ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二枚あるのですね。一枚は支払いの控えでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二枚の券の役割を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two. Is one a payment receipt?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the roles of the two tickets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いいえ。こちらが移動する区間の券で、もう一方が列車と席の券です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: No. This one covers the travel section, and the other covers the train and seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 支払いの控えだと思って、片方を家に置くところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 片方を控えだと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought one was a payment receipt and nearly left it at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought one was a receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この利用では、二枚とも必要になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: For this journey, you need both tickets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらに区間、こちらに列車と席がありますね。同じ旅に使う二種類の券なんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 区間と座席の記載を見分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The section is on this one, and the train and seat on this one. So they are two different kinds of ticket for the same trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the section details from the seat details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。日付と区間もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please check the date and section too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: どちらも今日で合っています。二枚とも持って乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参する券を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Both correctly show today. I will bring both when boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm which tickets you need to bring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 領収書が必要な場合は、別に発行します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you need a receipt, we will issue one separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は不要です。この二枚を同じケースへ入れて、なくさないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚をまとめて保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I do not need one today. I will put these two in the same case so I do not lose them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the two tickets together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二枚をそろえてお渡しします。案内に従ってお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will hand over the pair. Please use them according to the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知の回答についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about responding to the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。届いたので全員返すと思いましたが、「該当する方のみ」と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 回答が必要か質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Since I received it, I thought everyone had to reply, but it says “only those to whom this applies.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you need to reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの条件が分かりにくいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 期間中に住所が変わった人、とあります。私はその期間より前に引っ越しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象条件の文言を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says people whose address changed during the period. I moved before that period.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the wording of the eligibility condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の転居日と対象期間を、担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check your moving date and the relevant period with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらのメモが転居日です。対象だと決めて回答する前に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の該当状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: This note shows my moving date. I would like them to look before I decide I am eligible and reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your own circumstances regarding eligibility. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。回答が必要かを担当課でご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. The department in charge will tell you whether a reply is required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 対象期間の読み方も含めて聞きます。今は日付を無理に合わせて書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 判断を担当に確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will also ask how to interpret the relevant period. I will not force the dates to fit when writing now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the person in charge to check the decision. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通知と、転居日が分かる資料をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please bring the notice and documents showing your moving date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つとも持って行き、該当するか確かめてから回答します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未確認のまま回答欄を埋めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take both, check whether it applies to me, then reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not fill in the response before checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの担当窓口へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please proceed to this counter in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this your first medical visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この番号札を取りました。もう受付は済んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 番号札を示して受付状態を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I took this numbered ticket. Has my registration already been completed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the numbered ticket and ask your registration status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番号札は窓口でお呼びする順番です。お名前などの登録はまだですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The ticket gives the order in which we call you to the counter. Your name and other details have not been registered yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ資料を何も出していません。札を取るだけでは、診療の受付は終わらないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ情報を提出していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not submitted any documents yet. Taking a ticket alone does not complete registration for medical care.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not yet submitted your information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。番号でお呼びしたら、確認資料を窓口へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. When your number is called, bring your verification documents to the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらの資料を用意します。窓口へ出してから、診療の案内を受ける流れですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号札の役割を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will prepare these documents. So I submit them to the counter before receiving instructions about the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the numbered ticket's role. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのとおりです。問診票も窓口でお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Exactly. We will also give you a medical questionnaire at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号が呼ばれるまで、この資料と札を持って待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要な資料を窓口へ出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait with these documents and ticket until my number is called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Submit the required documents to the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 番号が呼ばれたら、札に書かれた番号のまま窓口へお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: When your number is called, come to the counter using the number written on that ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。受付済みと思って診察室へ行かず、まず番号の呼び出しを待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付後の待ち方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not go to the examination room thinking I am registered; I will wait for my number to be called first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm how to wait after reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。この待合席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please wait in these waiting seats.
